# Vendor logos

From [Simple Icons](https://simpleicons.org) 13.21.0 (`npm pack simple-icons@13.21.0`), whose SVG data is CC0 1.0. The marks themselves remain their owners' trademarks and are shown only to name the software each part of Rivendell uses. Microsoft's marks (Azure, PowerShell) aren't in Simple Icons, and the forensic tools have none there, so those keep name badges.
